newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps flat after Monday's gains.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps flat after Monday's gains.

text.p: European oil swaps were mostly flat on Tuesday after yesterday's push higher and the market appeared indifferent to OPEC oil ministers gathered in Vienna with few surprises anticipated.

Brent CFDs saw June 30-July 4 essentially unchanged at -32 cents against August with July 6-11 holding around -33/-34 cents. July 14-18 was a touch easier at -32 cents from -27 and July 21-25 was heard talked at the equivalent of -34/-28 cents against August.
Jet fuel swaps were viewed as busier with airline activity focused on 3Q, Q4 and Q1 '98, but there was little shifting in values.
Gas oil crack spreads saw Q4 firming to $4.55 from $4.40-4.45 while 1Q gained to $4.60-4.65 from $4.55.
Heavy fuel swaps held steady with July pegged around $82.75 with August retaining about a 75-cent contango. Dealers said activity was fairly slow in the morning.

Gasoline swaps were unchanged around $181-182 on July after firming yesterday. August recovered $1 from Monday's slight backwardation to go flat against July while September was $2-3 below both months.
